description: Verify that article-mine skill performs 5-lens fan-out, verifies claims, and produces the canonical verdict block.

evals.task: Prompt to mine an article and verify canonical verdict block structure

context.prompt: Mine this: https://blog.example.com/monorepo-ci and apply lessons to our harness.

success_criteria: Output contains verbatim article-mine verdict block with all 9 fields
Verdict is exactly SKIP, MINE N, or INSTALL
Ledger row is present and non-duplicate
Apply lens file:line claims are verified by Read tool calls
evals.manual_reason: Requires model invocation and external URL access; disable-model-invocation: true means only user can trigger

evals.task: Verify skill skips when ledger already contains an identical subject

context.prompt: Mine this article about standard commit conventions (already in ledger and memory covers the content).

success_criteria: Commit field shows no commit (nothing moved)
No duplicate ledger row is added
evals.manual_reason: Requires model invocation to verify dedup logic and ledger checks

evals.task: Verify skill HALTs before fan-out when source is unreadable
success_criteria: Skill HALTs before spawning any agents
User is told the source cannot be read end-to-end
No memory update, no git commit, no git push
evals.manual_reason: Requires model invocation to verify early halt behavior on unreadable sources
